text: As the night went on the dancing grew wilder. <break time="0.8s" /> But none of the guests dared. <break time="0.8s" /> To enter the black room in the west. <break time="0.8s" /> At last the clock began to strike midnight. <break time="0.8s" /> And once again the music stopped. <break time="0.8s" /> And everyone stood still. <break time="0.8s" /> Before the last echo had faded. <break time="0.8s" /> Many guests noticed a masked figure. <break time="0.8s" /> That no one had seen before. <break time="0.8s" /> Whispers spread quickly through the crowd. <break time="0.8s" /> And soon there was a murmur of surprise. <break time="0.8s" /> Then of fear. <break time="0.8s" /> And finally of horror. <break time="0.8s" /> The stranger was tall and thin. <break time="0.8s" /> And he was wrapped from head to foot. <break time="0.8s" /> In the clothes used for burying the dead. <break time="0.8s" /> His mask looked so much like the stiff face of a dead body. <break time="0.8s" /> That even a close look. <break time="0.8s" /> Could hardly tell the difference. <break time="0.8s" /> The guests might have accepted all this. <break time="0.8s" /> If he had not gone so far. <break time="0.8s" /> As to dress as the Red Death. <break time="0.8s" /> His robe and his face. <break time="0.8s" /> Were marked with scarlet spots. <break time="0.8s" /> The very sign of the terrible plague. <break time="0.8s" /> When Prince Prospero saw this ghostly figure. <break time="0.8s" /> He shook at first with fear. <break time="0.8s" /> But then his face turned red with anger. <break time="0.8s" /> Who dares to insult us. <break time="0.8s" /> With this cruel joke. <break time="0.8s" /> He cried. <break time="0.8s" /> Seize him. <break time="0.8s" /> And take off his mask.
